description: This PHP source file defines the MyInfoMenuConfigurator class within the OrangeHRM project. It implements the MenuConfigurator interface to configure menu items for the 'My Info' menu in the HRM system, utilizing traits and services to retrieve menu data.

classes.name: MyInfoMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the 'My Info' menu item within the OrangeHRM system, implementing the MenuConfigurator interface and using menu services to retrieve the menu item by title.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Returns the 'My Info' menu item with a specified ID by utilizing the menu service's DAO to fetch the item by its title.
